label: Not
description: Flips a yes/no answer: `value` comes out `false` when `true` went in, and `true` when `false` went in. Wire it into `_should_flow` when a step should run on a `false`. Only a Boolean fits the input, so a string or a number is refused when the program is checked, never guessed at. When nothing arrives (the branch feeding it closed), nothing comes out either.
